dates.label: Voter registration deadline (PASSED)
dates.quote: The deadline to register and be eligible to vote in the November 3, 2026 Election is October 5, 2026.

dates.label: Early voting (in person)
dates.quote: Early voting for the November 3 Election runs Oct. 19-30.

unverified: Election Day polling hours (7 a.m.-7 p.m. is standard in Texas; not re-verified this session)

rules: resident of the county where you register
at least 17y10m when applying and 18 on Election Day
not a felon with an uncompleted sentence
not declared mentally incapacitated without the right to vote by a court

moved_counties.note: Moved counties and missed re-registration? A "limited ballot" may be available during early voting only, at the main early voting location.
